semantic_notes: Root setup accepts only fixed protected lexical directories, no aliases or group/other writes/special modes; fixed bundle must be absent.
All payload pathname reads occur under unprivileged isolated OS Python; same buffered bytes must match accepted SHA256 before emission.
Root install receives only /dev/stdin and constant protected destination entries, not checkout paths.
Pipefail and errexit stop on reader/installer failure; partial protected input bundle is retained and not reused.
Helper revalidates protected files and the complete exact manifest/payload before creating its separate candidate.
Existing entrypoints/metadata are retained and explicitly not represented as relocation or rebuilt-wheel qualification.
